newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Asian dollar deposits quietly steady in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Asian dollar deposits quietly steady in late trade.

text.p: Asian dollar deposit rates were quietly steady in dull trade, dealers said on Monday.

"The market was quiet and featureless in the morning on some position adjustments. The market moved on narrow range trade amid uncertainty over the near-term direction of the market," a local dealer said.

"But some people are waiting for tonight's release of the March Federal Budget, for more clues to market direction. But I don't think there will be much impact unless the numbers are way off market expectations," he said.
In day-to-day rates, Monday/Tuesday eased 1/16 percentage point to 5-1/2 5-3/8 percent and Tuesday/Wednesday eased 1/8 point to 5-1/2 5-3/8 percent.
Week-fixed was unchanged from last Thursday's 5-5/8 5-1/2 percent.

Among longer dates, one-month was unchanged at 5-11/16 5-9/16 percent, three-months unchanged at 5-13/16 5-11/16, nine-months unchanged at 6-3/16 6-1/16 and twelve-months unchanged at 6-3/8 6-1/4 percent.
